text.p: Executone Information Systems Inc said Thursday it was comfortable with current earnings estimates for the 1997 year in the range of $0.20 to $0.26 per share.

In a statement, Alan Kessman, the company's president and chief executive, said that, "We are comfortable with current estimates of net income ranging from $.20 to $.26 per share, excluding any effect of Unistar, for 1997."
The First Call consensus on Executone's earnings for the 1997 year is $0.24 per share.
However, the company noted that quarterly results may vary, with the first and third quarters expected to be weaker than the second and fourth periods.

It said this variability to its earnings was a function of the high degree to which revenues are dependent on distributor shipments, and how its distributor contracts focus on attaining quotas at July 1 and January 1 of each year.
